scope: Only current resource_gate.py draft, not whole integration approval
positive_findings: Standard-library-only imports; draft/missing metadata/file checks precede any component GB hash and no model constructor is reachable here.
All5 actual file roles and published VMem/CLIP/CUT3R identities are checked before data hashing; original VAE pair requires a dedicated same-directory config/weight and claimed original revision.
Immediate stat recheck avoids a second GB hash; trusted-project guard is explicitly not an adversarial filesystem sandbox.
Fresh exclusive readiness receipt distinguishes NOT_READY_BEFORE_MODEL_IMPORT from PASS_RESOURCE_GATE; no download or auth behavior.

necessary_revisions.finding: source_identities need only be nonempty; review_receipts need only point to SHA-matching files. No approval status, scope, approved controls/source/component identities or VAE provenance is read. This can accidentally accept an old NOT_INTEGRATED or unrelated receipt and omit an actual execution module.
necessary_revisions.fix: Require the final bounded execution source domain (at least gate/integration/archive/factory/runner plus actual delegated originals/trace controls), and inspect the3 receipt schemas/statuses and their approved preparation core/source/controls/VAE file identities. Bind a noncircular candidate/core identity or exact reviewed fields, not mutually recursive final-manifest and receipt SHAs.

necessary_revisions.finding: validate_gate verifies the manifest file hash but never compares supplied gate component/source records against its JSON content. A wrong or stale manually assembled gate can retain a correct manifest hash while using other component records.
necessary_revisions.fix: Read the already-small manifest and compare its role/path/size/SHA/source-domain/controls fields to the gate exactly, then perform current stat/source checks. Do not call full check_manifest again or rehash GB files.

recorded_execution_boundary: PASS_RESOURCE_GATE only permits the next reviewed loading stage. It is not actual model construction, generation or scientific completion; a recorded_execution trace still needs the legitimate live pipeline/runtime source chain and observed calls.
proposed_minimal_checks: Actual negative missing-component entry stops before scientific imports/model/weight access.
Draft or wrong-manifest entry stops before loading; retained failure receipt is not a generation result.
After correction, a mismatched source/component gate is rejected using metadata-only fixtures, without fabricating positive whole-resource readiness.
next: Root patches this bounded draft and binds its final version with the remaining implementation; different-author final integration source review is still pending.
